# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 15 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_015_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 15

**15:1** Now Annas the scribe came to him and said to him, "Why did you not appear in our assembly?" And Joseph said to him, "Because I was weary from my journey, and I rested the first day." And Annas turned and saw Mary with child.

**15:2** And he went running to the priest and said to him, "Joseph, whom you testified concerning, has grievously transgressed." And the priest said, "How so?" And he said, "The virgin whom he received from the temple of the Lord, he has defiled her, and has stealthily consummated his marriage with her, and has not revealed it to the children of Israel."

**15:3** And the priest said, "Has Joseph done this?" And Annas said, "Send servants, and you will find the virgin with child." And the servants went and found it as he said, and they brought her with Joseph to the tribunal.

**15:4** And the priest said, "Mary, why have you done this? Why have you humbled your soul and forgotten the Lord your God, you who were brought up in the Holy of Holies and received food from the hand of an angel and heard their hymns and danced before them? Why have you done this?"

**15:5** But she wept bitterly, saying, "As the Lord God lives, I am pure before him, and I know not a man."

**15:6** And the priest said, "Joseph, why have you done this?" And Joseph said, "As the Lord my God lives, I am pure concerning her." And the priest said, "Do not bear false witness, but speak the truth. You have stealthily consummated your marriage and have not revealed it to the children of Israel, and you have not bowed your head under the mighty hand that your offspring might be blessed."

**15:7** And Joseph was silent.
